segments.text:
V. 19.
Lay not up for yourſelves—Our LORD here makes a Tranſition from religious to common Actions, and warns us of another Snare, the Love of Money, as inconſiſtent with Purity of Intention, as the Love of Praiſe. Where ruſt and moth conſume—Where all Things are periſhable and tranſient.

He may likewiſe have a farther View in theſe Words, even to guard us againſt making any Thing on Earth our Treaſure. For then a Thing properly becomes our Treaſure, when we ſet our Affections upon it.
